title.en: When is Type 311 the spraying machine to open?
title.zh: 什么时候打开 311 砂浆喷涂机？

description.en: Fine mortar inside 2 m³/h, ≤ 2 mm, 15 m / 5 m, on 220/380 V and a 4 kW motor. It is not a trailer pump.
description.zh: 细砂浆在 2 m³/h、≤ 2 mm、15 m / 5 m 内，电源 220/380V，电机 4 kW。它不是拖泵。

h1.en: When is Type 311 the spraying machine to open?
h1.zh: 什么时候打开 311 砂浆喷涂机？

directAnswer.en: When the job is fine mortar inside the printed window. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Type 311 at 220/380 V, 4 kW, 2 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, hose 25 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤ 1:3, particle ≤ 2 mm, 15 m horizontal / 5 m vertical, 1500 × 420 × 900 mm and 150 kg. It is not Type 511 and not a concrete pump.
directAnswer.zh: 作业是已印窗口内的细砂浆时。邢台河北品锦机械把 311 列为 220/380V、4 kW、2 m³/h、3–5 MPa、管径 25 mm、砂灰比 ≤ 1:3、粒径 ≤ 2 mm、水平 15 m / 垂直 5 m、外形 1500 × 420 × 900 mm、150 kg。它不是 511，也不是混凝土泵。

heading.en: ≤ 2 mm is the reason to stay here
heading.zh: ≤ 2 mm 是留在这里的理由

body.en: Type 511 prints ≤ 6 mm, 3 m³/h, 7.5 kW and 30 m / 15 m on 380 V only. The double-cylinder plunger prints ≤ 8 mm and 4 m³/h. If the particle is above 2 mm, Type 311 is the wrong page even if the hose run is short.
body.zh: 511 印的是 ≤ 6 mm、3 m³/h、7.5 kW、30 m / 15 m，并且只要 380V。双缸柱塞式印的是 ≤ 8 mm、4 m³/h。粒径超过 2 mm 时，即使软管很短，311 也是错页。

heading.en: 25 mm hose is shared with M9 only as a diameter
heading.zh: 25 mm 软管和 M9 只是管径相同

body.en: M9 also prints 25 mm, but it is a plaster machine at 30 L/min, 50 bar, ≤ 4 mm and 50 m / 20 m on 380 V/50 Hz. Type 311 is a 2 m³/h mortar machine with a 5 m vertical cell. Do not treat the shared hose diameter as the same job.
body.zh: M9 也印了 25 mm，但它是石膏机：30 L/min、50 bar、≤ 4 mm、50 m / 20 m、380V/50Hz。311 是 2 m³/h 的砂浆机，垂直格是 5 m。不要把相同的管径当成同一种作业。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Send particle size in millimetres and whether you have 220 V or 380 V. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请发送粒径（毫米），以及你有 220V 还是 380V。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: No. Horizontal is 15 m. Vertical is 5 m.
answer.zh: 不是。水平是 15 m。垂直是 5 m。

answer.en: The printed particle limit is ≤ 2 mm. Centimetre aggregate belongs on a concrete pump page.
answer.zh: 已印粒径上限是 ≤ 2 mm。厘米级骨料属于混凝土泵页面。
